title: Hⁿ⌞M has upper density at most 1 at almost every point (Simon 1.3.26(1))
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and assume (IB): μHE[n] ≤ (ω_n/2ⁿ)·μH[n] as measures on ℝ^P, where ω_n = unitBallVolume n. Let M ⊆ ℝ^P be Borel with μHE[n](M) < ∞. Then for μHE[n]⌞M-almost every a ∈ ℝ^P, limsup_{r→0+} μHE[n](M ∩ B̄_r(a))/(ω_n·rⁿ) ≤ 1. The quotients are taken in [0, ∞], with ω_n·rⁿ written unitBallVolume n * ofReal(rⁿ).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)), (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)) ≤ (unitBallVolume n / 2 ^ n) • (μH[(n : ℝ)] : Measure (Euclid P)) → MeasurableSet M → μHE[n] M < ∞ → ∀ᵐ a ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), limsup (fun r : ℝ => μHE[n] (M ∩ closedBall a r) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) ≤ 1
